build_SemSegHouseData: build a SemSegHouseData PyTorch dataset from a pickled Minecraft house segmentation data file
build_SemSegShapeData: build a SemSegShapeData PyTorch dataset from pickled shape data or generate random shapes
build_SemSegData: build a combined SemSegData dataset mixing Minecraft house and shape segmentation examples
create_make_example_from_raw: create a normalized 32x32x32 voxel example from raw schematic data with optional augmentation
create_flip_rotate: create a randomly rotated or flipped 3D voxel cube for data augmentation
